title: 第2章  龙妹妹，暴打陈金旺！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“青山哥！救我！”

小丫头被人抓住胳膊，清秀脸蛋被吓得惨白，惊恐地尖叫起来。

“我操你妈！”

宋青山眼珠子瞬间红了，抡起拳头，狠狠砸在拉人的混混面门上。

鼻血狂飙，混混也跟着惨叫摔倒在地！

从小在地里干活，宋青山别的没有，力气还是有一把的，至少比这些被酒色掏空身子的混混强。

可好汉也架不住群狗。

周围混混见同伴吃亏，短暂惊愕后便对宋青山一拥而上，拳头如雨点般朝宋青山招呼。

起初宋青山还能硬扛着反击，但很快便被打翻在地，死死按住！

混乱中。

陈金旺狞笑中啐了一口浓痰，上前抬起脚，狠狠踹在宋青山胸口。

不偏不倚，正中心窝！

“唔……”

宋青山闷哼一声，感觉心脏跟着骤然停顿了几秒。

剧烈眩晕感袭来，眼前景物开始变得模糊，耳边林桃的哭喊声也变得越来越远。

意识逐渐陷入黑暗。

要死了吗？

我不甘心……我死了小桃怎么办……

家里祖传是郎中，宋青山知道这种浑身发冷、眼皮沉重代表着什么。

就在宋青山要闭上眼睛时，什么东西忽然掉在了他的旁边，发出一道声响。

勉强抬起眼皮看去，是一尾金色鲤鱼。

这是前些天抓鱼卖的时候，从塘子里发现的。

纯金色鲤鱼十分少见，贩子花足足两千元收，宋青山准备卖的时候，发现这金色鲤鱼居然流眼泪，像是在害怕。

宋青山当时鬼使神差地心软了。

没卖，养在缸里。

不过这鲤鱼一直病恹恹的，现在怎么有力气从大水缸里蹦出来？

算了，关我屁事，我都要死了！

啪——！

就在宋青山要睡着的时候，脸上传来火辣辣疼痛。

被金色鲤鱼用尾巴抽了！

“谢谢你提醒我不能睡，但我真的要不行了。”

“知道感谢，说明你还清醒，清醒就更不能睡了！算了，看在你助我渡过龙门劫的份上，我就救你这一次！”

奶声奶气的小女孩声音，在宋青山脑海突兀响起。

“看来真要死了，居然都出现幻觉，听到鲤鱼在说话！”宋青山苦笑。

“姑奶奶被你气死了！什么幻听！”

“还有！姑奶奶现在已经不是鲤鱼！是龙！是这世界上最后一条越过龙门的龙！”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Brother Qingshan! Save me!"

The little girl was grabbed by the arm, her delicate face turned pale with fright, and she screamed in horror.

"I'll fuck you!"

Song Qingshan's eyes turned red instantly, he raised his fist and hit the door of the gangster who was pulling him hard.

The nosebleeds were violent, and the gangster screamed and fell to the ground!

Having worked in the fields since he was a child, Song Qingshan had nothing but strength. At least he was stronger than these gangsters who had been drained by drinking and sex.

But even a good man cannot stand up to a pack of dogs.

The gangsters around him were stunned for a moment when they saw that their companions had suffered a loss, and then they rushed towards Song Qingshan, and greeted Song Qingshan with fists like raindrops.

At first, Song Qingshan was still able to fight back, but he was soon knocked to the ground and held down tightly!

In chaos.

Chen Jinwang spat out a thick phlegm with a hideous smile, stepped forward, raised his foot, and kicked Song Qingshan's chest hard.

Unbiased, right in the center!

"Well..."

Song Qingshan groaned and felt his heart suddenly pause for a few seconds.

A severe dizziness hit him, the scene in front of him began to become blurry, and Lin Tao's cries in his ears became farther and farther away.

Consciousness gradually fades into darkness.

Dying?

I'm not willing to give in... What will Xiao Tao do if I die...

His family was a doctor, so Song Qingshan knew what this coldness and heavy eyelids meant.

Just when Song Qingshan was about to close his eyes, something suddenly fell next to him and made a sound.

He reluctantly raised his eyelids and saw a golden carp.

I found this in the pond when I was catching fish to sell a few days ago.

Pure golden carps are very rare, and the dealer spent a full two thousand yuan to buy them. When Song Qingshan was about to sell them, he found that the golden carp actually shed tears, as if he was scared.

Song Qingshan suddenly became soft-hearted at that time.

Not sold, kept in a tank.

But this carp has always been sick. How can it have the strength to jump out of the big water tank now?

Forget it, it’s none of my business, I’m going to die!

Snap——!

Just when Song Qingshan was about to fall asleep, he felt burning pain on his face.

Being whipped by the golden carp with its tail!

"Thank you for reminding me that I can't sleep, but I really can't."

"Thank you, it means you are still awake, and you can't sleep even if you are awake! Forget it, for the sake of helping me survive the Dragon Gate Tribulation, I will save you this time!"

The milky little girl's voice suddenly sounded in Song Qingshan's mind.

"It seems that he is really going to die. He actually hallucinated and heard the carp talking!" Song Qingshan smiled bitterly.

"My aunt is so angry with you! What an auditory hallucination!"

"Also! My aunt is no longer a carp! She is a dragon! She is the last dragon in the world to cross the dragon gate!"
